# Observability Stack

The observability stack collects metrics, logs and traces from every service, with alerting rules for latency budgets, error rates and [[kafka-bus]] consumer lag. Maintained by [[henrique-alves]] on [[team-platform]]. Dashboards are linked from the [[oncall-runbook]]. Traces are sampled at 10%.
